paths.title: Enlightened Word
paths.description: Speak the words of a celestial heaven and ride a cloud of light above the fray. The cloud step rune state lets allies shift after each hit, then lets you fly, becoming insubstantial and phasing at higher levels. An action point can send your attacks from an ally's space, granting that ally temporary hit points. Your powers call lightning and radiance onto your enemies, banish afflictions with a touch, and stun a foe until it turns on its own allies.

paths.title: Hammer of Vengeance
paths.description: Punish anyone who dares to hurt your friends. An action point makes enemies suffer radiant damage when they hit your allies near you, while a vengeance rune state lets you answer an ally's hit with a basic attack of your own that later grows more accurate and brutal with Constitution. You can bring a harassing foe next to you, turn an attack on an ally into a boon for them, and, once you are bloodied, deliver a devastating radiant blow.

paths.title: Master of the Forge
paths.description: Treat your runes as a blacksmith's tools, tempering the weapons and armor of the whole party. An action point drives every nearby ally's weapon damage higher, and after each rest you can touch a weapon for lasting force or a suit of heavy armor for greater toughness. Your powers awaken the strength of iron to reinforce allies' strikes or heavy armor, bless a friend's armor with a quick touch, and ignite a foe with forge fire that makes your allies' melee attacks burn.

paths.title: Rune Shield
paths.description: Plant a shield of golden runes around the party and make every ally harder to hit. Entering the rune state of the iron shield boosts all defenses for friends beside you, and the bonus doubles at higher levels, while an action point strengthens everyone you can see. Your powers batter foes backward from a floating rune, form a zone that halts enemy movement, and mark a foe with a radiant shield that hounds its attacks and can halve the damage it deals to an ally.
